customMethods.script:
thisflex = int(selfButton.meta.name.replace("Section",""))
	flexcount = selfButton.view.getChild("root").custom.flexcount
	
	# Loop over all flex containers
	for i in range(1, flexcount+1):
	    flex = selfButton.getSibling("FlexContainer" + str(i))
	    button = selfButton.getSibling("Section" + str(i))
	    
	    if i == thisflex:
	        # Show the chosen one
	        flex.position.display = not flex.position.display
	        
	        if flex.position.display:
	        	selfButton.parent.position.basis = str(int(flex.position.basis.replace("px",""))+labelsHeight)+"px"
	        	selfButton.parent.position.shrink = 0
	        	button.props.style.classes = 'button-questions'
	        else: 
	        	selfButton.parent.position.shrink = 1
	    else:
	        # Hide the rest
	        flex.position.display = False
	        button.props.style.classes = 'button-questions-2'

	status = "Finalizado"
	now = system.date.now()
	
	from java.lang import String
	query = """
		SELECT TOP 1 RegisterCode
		FROM registerhistory
		WHERE WorkstationNodeID=? AND PapoID=?
		ORDER BY ID DESC
	"""


	result = system.db.runPrepQuery(query, [workstationNodeID,papoID], "papo_db")
	
	regCode = result.getValueAt(0,0)

	def insert_answer(registerTypeID, answerJson, regCode):
		if not answerJson:
			return
		query = """
			INSERT INTO registerhistory (
				[Timestamp],
				DataAnswer,
				Status,
				PapoID,
				RegisterTypeID,
				[User],
				WorkstationNodeID,
				NodeID,
				WorkstationID,
				RegisterCode
			)
			VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ? ,?)
		"""
		
		# ⚠️ Aseguramos que sea String plano
		data_answer_str = String(answerJson)
		
		params = [
			now,
			data_answer_str,
			status,
			papoID,
			registerTypeID,
			user,

			workstationID,
			regCode

	)

customMethods.name: flexToggleRoot
customMethods.script:
"""
	Alterna un FlexContainer dentro del grupo FlexContainer_StartX del botón presionado
	y garantiza que SOLO UNO quede visible en TODOS los grupos (Start1, Start2, ...).
	Asume nombres:
	  - Grupos:   FlexContainer_Start1, FlexContainer_Start2, ...
	  - Contenido: FlexContainer1..N
	  - Botones:  Section1..N  (selfButton.meta.name = 'SectionX')
	"""

	root = self
	current_group = selfButton.parent  # El contenedor FlexContainer_StartX del botón
	thisIndex = int(selfButton.meta.name.replace("Section", ""))
	logging.log("FlexIndex = {}".format(thisIndex), "debug")

	# --- Helpers -------------------------------------------------------------
	def _get_groups():
		"""Lista todos los FlexContainer_StartN bajo root."""
		groups = []
		i = 1
		while True:
			try:
				groups.append(root.getChild("FlexContainer_Start{}".format(i)))
				i += 1
			except:
				break
		logging.log("Number of FlexContainer_StartX = {}".format(i-1), "debug")
		return groups
	
	def _count_flex(group):
		"""Cuenta cuántos FlexContainerN hay dentro de un grupo dado."""
		n, i = 0, 1
		while True:
			try:
				group.getChild("FlexContainer{}".format(i))
				n += 1
				i += 1
			except:
				break
		logging.log("Number of FlexContainerX = {}".format(n), "debug")
		return n
	# ------------------------------------------------------------------------

	groups = _get_groups()
	
	# Estado nuevo del seleccionado (toggle). Si quieres que SIEMPRE quede uno abierto,
	# reemplaza la línea siguiente por: new_state = True
	try:
		selected_flex = current_group.getChild("FlexContainer{}".format(thisIndex))
		new_state = not selected_flex.position.display
	except:
		# Si no existe el FlexContainerX esperado, salimos silenciosamente
		return

	# 1) Ocultar TODO en TODOS los grupos y resetear estilos
	for g in groups:
		count = _count_flex(g)
		for i in range(1, count + 1):
			try:
				f = g.getChild("FlexContainer{}".format(i))
				b = g.getChild("Section{}".format(i))
				f.position.display = False
				b.props.style.classes = 'button-questions-2'
			except:
				pass
		# Compactar por defecto el grupo
		try:
			g.position.shrink = 1
		except:
			pass

	# 2) Si corresponde, mostrar el seleccionado y ajustar estilos/altura del grupo
	if new_state:
		selected_flex.position.display = True
		selfButton.props.style.classes = 'button-questions'
		try:
			current_group.position.shrink = 0
			# Ajustar altura del grupo usando el basis del flex seleccionado + labelsHeight
			basis_val = str(selected_flex.position.basis)
			basis_px = int(basis_val.replace("px", "")) if isinstance(basis_val, (str, unicode)) else int(basis_val)
			current_group.position.basis = str(basis_px + int(labelsHeight)) + "px"
		except:
			pass
